opening.argument: The walkthrough expressly directs viewers to recruit new members through a personal sponsoring link, stating that "anybody from around the world can use your Sponsoring Link and sign up in your network." It then describes the structure as binary, with "two leg's, left and right," and explains that a new member may be placed on either side because "this is binary." The dashboard reinforces that recruitment-dependent structure by displaying leadership rank, directly sponsored members, bonus earned, and other account metrics. Taken together, these instructions and account fields show active facilitation of participation through sponsoring and placement in downline legs, rather than reporting on or criticizing the arrangement.

citations.quote: The other way is to send out link link, Personal Sponsoring Link, and anybody from around the world can use your Sponsoring Link and sign up in your network.
